answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 37025 Country: India Title: Is mobile recharging haram or halal, because company gives 2 or 3% commission on recharging someone's mobile Question: Is mobile recharging haram or halal, because company gives 2 or 3% commission on recharging someone's mobile? Please tell me is mobile recharging haram or halal? Answer ID: 37025 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 415/202/L=1433) It is lawful to do mobile recharge. Also it is right to take the 2 or 3 percentage commission on recharge. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
